authority: Candidate adapter only; no DOM connection, second renderer or production import
notVerified: Native pointer/touch gesture behavior of camera-controls; production keeps the existing OrbitControls gesture contract
Candidate panel offsets; production pixel-inset fitting has its own eight-corner projection tests

decision: Candidate supports small/large box fit, stop and restore.
